# `adi-workflows` — types

> The WORKFLOWS engine (ADI-MONO-141 §E): discovers the TypeScript workflow files under `workflows/` and `projects/<id>/workflows/`, starts a run when their `on: schedule(cron, tz) | event(pattern, where?) | manual()` fires, pours its row + root task + `adi.workflows.run.started` event, and drives it — a fresh `bun` process per attempt, relaying each `ctx` checkpoint (step/task/run/waitFor/sleep/ask) over a line-delimited JSON pipe, journaling every resolution so replay is instant and an unresolved checkpoint just suspends the attempt cleanly — through to `adi.workflows.run.completed/failed`. See the crate docs.

17 structs · 6 enums · 1 type alias across 11 files.

### struct `Attempt`

Drives one run's attempts: spawns the harness, answers its checkpoints, finalizes the root task. Cheap to build fresh per call — see `crate::Engine`'s own `pourer()` for the same pattern this mirrors.

```rust
    store: WorkflowStore,
    tasks: Tasks,
    events: Events,
}
```

```rust
        cron: String,

        catch_up: Option<String>,

    #[serde(rename = "event")]

```

### struct `WorkflowShape`

A workflow file's whole declared shape, as `describe` reads it: its triggers, and the JSON Schema of its `input`/`output` zod exports (`null` when a file declares neither — a workflow is not obliged to type its input or output). Converted from zod by the describe harness itself (`z.toJSONSchema`), never re-derived on the Rust side, which has no zod of its own.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Deserialize)]
pub struct WorkflowShape {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub on: Vec<TriggerDef>,
    #[serde(default, rename = "inputSchema")]
    pub input_schema: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(default, rename = "outputSchema")]
    pub output_schema: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}
```

## `src/event.rs`

### struct `WorkflowRunStarted`

`adi.workflows.run.started` — a workflow run was poured: its row and root task both exist.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct WorkflowRunStarted {
    pub run_key: String,
    pub workflow: String,
    pub root_task: String,
    pub cause: Value,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub caused_by_run: Option<String>,
}
```

### struct `WorkflowRunCompleted`

`adi.workflows.run.completed` — a run's workflow body returned, its output validated against its own `output` zod shape, and its root task completed with that value as the result.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct WorkflowRunCompleted {
    pub run_key: String,
    pub workflow: String,
    pub root_task: String,
    pub result: Value,
    pub caused_by_run: String,
}
```

### struct `WorkflowRunFailed`

`adi.workflows.run.failed` — a run ended in an error the workflow body never caught: a thrown exception, a reused step key, an `input`/`output` zod mismatch, or an uncaught `TaskGaveUp`. Its root task is given up on (not completed — there is no result that would satisfy its own `output_schema`), with this same message as the reason.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct WorkflowRunFailed {
    pub run_key: String,
    pub workflow: String,
    pub root_task: String,
    pub reason: String,
    pub caused_by_run: String,
}
```

### struct `StartedRun`

One run a tick started, whichever starter poured it — `Engine::schedule_tick` and `Engine::event_tick` both answer in this shape, so a caller logging "what fired" doesn't need to know or care which starter it came from (the same reporting shape `adi-agents`' own dispatch/goals ticks use for their own "what happened").

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct StartedRun {
    pub run_key: String,
    pub workflow: String,
}
```

### struct `Engine`

Bundles every store this crate's starters need, and the two ticks that drive them — the one thing a host process (`adi-app`) holds and calls once a second, beside its dispatch/goals/ awaits ticks.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Engine {
    config: Config,
    runs: WorkflowStore,
    schedules: ScheduleStore,
    tasks: Tasks,
    events: Events,
}
```

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]

pub enum Request {
    #[serde(rename = "step")]
    Step {
        key: String,
    },

    StepSave {
        key: String,
        value: Value,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "task")]
    Task {
        key: String,
        title: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        agent: Option<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        person: Option<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        instructions: Option<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        input: Option<Value>,
        #[serde(default, rename = "outputSchema")]
        output_schema: Option<Value>,
        #[serde(default, rename = "timeoutMs")]
        timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
        #[serde(default)]
        project: Option<String>,
        #[serde(default)]
        cwd: Option<String>,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "run")]
    Run {
        key: String,
        workflow: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        input: Option<Value>,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "waitFor")]
    WaitFor {
        key: String,
        event: String,
        #[serde(default, rename = "where")]
        where_clause: Option<serde_json::Map<String, Value>>,
        #[serde(default, rename = "timeoutMs")]
        timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "sleep")]
    Sleep {
        key: String,
        until: i64,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "ask")]
    Ask {
        key: String,
        person: String,
        text: String,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "result")]
    Result {
        value: Value,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "error")]
    Error {
        message: String,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "gave_up")]
    GaveUp {
        reason: String,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "suspend")]
    Suspend {
    },
}
```
